results.title: x-forwarded-for as the hosted PostgREST hands it to SQL (client header spoofed)
results.detail: RPC ready in 3s (HTTP 200/200). Without a client header x-forwarded-for carries 1 address(es); with x-forwarded-for=203.0.113.9 it carries 2: APPENDED - client value first, then the edge's address. Address-bearing header keys present: cf-connecting-ip,cf-ew-via,cf-ipcountry,x-forwarded-for,x-forwarded-proto.
